name: Powerwise Systems
old_description: electricity meter is part of a solid and proven energy management platform, available since 2010.
about:
Powerwise Systems is based in Bucksport, Maine, and was founded in 2010. The company emerged from a team that previously worked at RainWise, Inc., a 47-year-old weather station manufacturer. Several team members helped create the PVmet line of weather stations for commercial and industrial solar PV, with more than 9,500 units installed worldwide. The chief executive is also the co-inventor of the patented SiteSage monitoring technology.

The company designs and supplies solar meteorological (MET) stations, sensors, and revenue-grade electricity, gas, and water meters for residential and commercial buildings. Its platform provides whole-house energy monitoring, BTU metering for thermal systems, and solar production tracking. Powerwise also performs MET station installation and commissioning, civil work, and ongoing operations and maintenance for large-scale photovoltaic installations.

Customers include solar developers, building owners, and property managers who need to measure energy use by tenant, circuit, or building. The systems serve utility-scale solar farms, commercial rooftop arrays, and multi-tenant properties seeking granular energy cost allocation. The company’s vendor relationships span EKO Instruments, Campbell Scientific, Hukseflux, Kipp & Zonen, RainWise, RM Young, and Atonometrics.

Powerwise differentiates itself through deep domain expertise: its lead engineer authored the first edition of the SunSpec standard for weather stations, and the team brings over 40 years of weather station experience. The firm tailors MET systems to project specifications and budgets, offering a single source for hardware, installation, and long-term service.

name: Pratt (Bell Packaging), Inc.
old_description: Fifth Largest Corrugated Packaging Company in the US. World's Largest, Privately-Held Producer of 100% Recycled Containerboard.
about:
Pratt (Bell Packaging), Inc., operating as Pratt Industries, is headquartered in Wyoming, Michigan. Founded in 1985, the company is privately held and has grown into the fifth-largest corrugated packaging company in the United States and the world's largest privately held producer of 100% recycled containerboard.

The company operates a vertically integrated supply chain that spans 19 recycling facilities, six paper mills, 21 corrugating plants, 25 converting plants, 17 retail display facilities, and 46 transportation facilities. Its hub-and-spoke network collects recyclable materials while delivering finished boxes, feeding recovered fiber into its mills to produce 100% recycled paper for corrugated sheets, packaging, and displays. A customer team of over 300 supports design, logistics, and supply-chain management.

Pratt serves a range of industries with a noted focus on the Southeast agriculture market, providing custom corrugated boxes, palletized truckloads, and retail displays. Its logistics division manages dedicated fleets, brokerage, and shipping agency services for local, regional, and national distribution.

The company's differentiation rests on its "green mission" — using recycling as a tool against climate change — and its independence as a privately held business that prioritizes people, customers, and the planet. In 2022, executive chairman Anthony Pratt pledged a $5 billion investment in U.S. recycling and clean energy infrastructure, aiming to create 5,000 manufacturing jobs by 2032.

name: Precise Circuits Inc
old_description: Precise Circuits designs, develops, prototypes, integrates, tests and manufactures custom electronic
about:
Precise Circuits Inc operates from Carrollton, Texas. The company traces its roots to 1995 when it began as a specialist in custom electronic design and manufacturing. In recent years it was acquired by Daburn Electronics, a wire, cable, and power supply manufacturer founded in 1964, which is expanding Precise Circuits' design and manufacturing operations in Carrollton.

Precise Circuits designs, develops, prototypes, integrates, tests, and manufactures custom electronic assemblies and sub-assemblies. Its in-house capabilities include electronic circuit design, PCB layout, high-temperature testing up to 200°C, wiring harness design and manufacture, and both surface-mount and thru-hole assembly. The company offers turnkey solutions or can participate in specific project phases, focusing on hardware design and the production of small to medium quantities with rapid turnaround. It also sources obsolete components and designs work-arounds or complete replacements. With over 30 years of experience, the firm has developed high-temperature downhole tools for open-hole and production logging, memory tools, and ruggedized equipment for oil-field and mining applications.

The company serves the oil and gas and mining sectors, providing downhole logging tools and ruggedized electronics for harsh environments. Its customers include operators needing custom electronic assemblies, turnkey manufacturing, and obsolescence management for legacy systems.

Precise Circuits emphasizes its strength in hardware design coupled with manufacturing of small to medium runs at reasonable cost and quick turnaround. The acquisition by Daburn Electronics adds the resources of a larger organization to enhance R&D, product development, and customer service, while maintaining ISO 9001 and AS9100 quality certifications.

about:
Precision Architectural Metals, Inc. (PAM) was founded in 1994 as a division of Georgetown Roofing, Inc. in Capitol Heights, Maryland. The company operates as a veteran-owned, service-disabled small business from a 40,000-square-foot facility in nearby Hyattsville, Maryland, just outside Washington, D.C.

PAM specializes in architectural sheet metal fabrication, offering large-volume brake forming, custom fabrication of unusual and antique items, and CNC plasma cutting. The shop stocks more than 150 colors, materials, and gauges of architectural sheet metal, including Kynar-coated products from manufacturers. Computer-controlled equipment and a patented fabrication process enable production of virtually any item detailed in the SMACNA architectural sheet metal manual.

The company serves customers throughout the mid-Atlantic region, ranging from single-person operations to large commercial contractors. Its client base includes roofing contractors, architectural firms, and general construction companies requiring precision sheet metal components.

PAM differentiates itself with a 24- to 48-hour turnaround on most orders—far faster than the typical six- to eight-week lead times of out-of-town fabricators. The combination of extensive local inventory, high-tech equipment, and a patented process allows the company to fill orders quickly at competitive prices.

name: Precision Cables
old_description: Precision Cables uses all of the most modern technology in cable manufacturing to provide you the highest quality products in a short amount of time.
about:
Precision Cables operates from American Fork, Utah. The company was founded by Raymond Mulitalo and Mauro Carlini, who serve as co-owners, after they experienced recurrent quality issues with previous cable suppliers and identified a market gap for reliable, high-quality cable products.

The company manufactures custom and standardized cable assemblies, wire harnesses, and electromechanical box builds. Its services include cable assembly, harness routing and assembly, over molding, testing, consignment/turnkey supply, and mechanical box builds. The facility is equipped with formboards for 100% continuity testing, harness drawing software, mating harness test fixtures, in-line inkjet circuit printing, a woven nylon braiding machine, and a height and pull tester. No headcount or volume figures are disclosed.

Precision Cables serves automotive (including farming and mining), commercial (audio, instrumentation, electro-mechanical, Ethernet, Cat 5, data), law enforcement/military (drone, autonomous, safety systems), and industrial (oil, drone, aerospace) sectors.

The company emphasizes quality assurance through IPC/WHMA-A-620 trained personnel capable of class 2 and 3 workmanship, pursuit of ISO 9001:2015 registration, RoHS compliance, and a custom-solutions approach with engineering support. It also offers consignment and turnkey supply models to streamline customer operations.

name: Precision Circuits
old_description: Precision Circuits’ mission is to be the leading provider of total electronics solutions to the specialty vehicle industry.
about:
Precision Circuits, headquartered in Downers Grove, Illinois, was founded in 2001 as an employee-owned enterprise. The company began with a focus on delivering total electronics solutions to the specialty vehicle market, leveraging in-house design and manufacturing capabilities.

The firm designs, manufactures, and assembles custom electronic products, including battery disconnects, isolation managers, touch-screen displays, multiplex systems, battery control centers, 120 V distribution panels, power control systems, switch panels, tank-level sensors, LCD controls, wireless LIN modules, HVAC control modules, water-pump controllers, and associated wiring harnesses. Operations span product development, firmware programming, mechanical design, and final assembly, serving both OEM and aftermarket channels.

Precision Circuits serves the specialty vehicle sector, with a strong presence in recreational vehicles (RVs) and commercial vehicle upfits. Its customer roster includes major RV builders such as Airstream, Winnebago, Forest River, Jayco, Tiffin Motorhomes, and Grand Design, as well as commercial upfitters like Knapheide and Utilimaster. The company also supports solar-energy integrators such as Solar Energy Systems LLC and Dragonfly Energy.

The company attributes its differentiation to its employee-ownership model, which it says fosters a more engaged workforce, and to its deep knowledge of specialty vehicle electrical systems. A stated commitment to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction underpins its mission to be the provider of total electronics solutions for the specialty vehicle industry.

about:
Precision Electronics, Inc. (PEI) is based in Hickory, North Carolina. The company was founded in 1994 by Chris Cerrito, who remains president. It began as an industrial electronic repair business and has grown to serve manufacturers across North America and internationally.

PEI specializes in industrial electronic repair and MRO (maintenance, repair, and operations) product supply. Its repair facility handles variable frequency drives (VFDs), robot teach pendants, servo drives, touch screens, and rebuilt spares from all major brands. The company offers free repair evaluations, rush services, load testing of all drives, and software backups for drive and control systems. It also supplies industrial controls and sourcing support. No facility size or headcount figures are disclosed.

The company serves manufacturers in industries such as paper, plastics, building products, wood products, and general industrial automation. Named customers include International Paper, Munot Plastics, Boral Building Products, Plasman Group, Cummins-Wagner Co., Atlas Machine & Supply, and Ed McGinnis Wood Products.

PEI emphasizes long-term relationships over quick sales, honoring warranties and prioritizing quality over shortcuts. It positions itself as a single source for industrial controls, supplies, and repairs, offering like-new performance at 30–65% of the cost of new equipment.

name: Precision Fabrics Group Inc.
old_description: Innovation is far more than just a good idea or a successful product. At Precision Fabrics, innovation is our passion. It fuels our work and is the keystone to our success.
about:
Precision Fabrics Group is headquartered in Greensboro, North Carolina, with manufacturing plants in North Carolina and Virginia. The company was created in 1988 when Lanty L. Smith led a leveraged buyout of the Precision Fabrics Division from Burlington Industries, and it remains a privately held business today. Smith, a former president of Burlington, founded the company to acquire the existing textile operations and steer them toward engineered materials.

The company produces highly technical woven and nonwoven engineered materials. Its Vinton, Virginia plant specializes in weaving continuous-filament fabrics, while the Greensboro, North Carolina facility focuses on a broad range of nonwoven products. Core processes include fine-filament weaving, finishing, and the application of chemistries and laminations to nonwoven substrates. Precision Fabrics employs approximately 600 associates and offers a wide spectrum of technical properties such as acoustic absorption, flame resistance, antimicrobial protection, electromagnetic interference shielding, and fluid repellency.

Precision Fabrics serves high-performance industries including aerospace, military, medical, protective garments, automotive, home appliances, and wind energy. Its materials are used in applications such as acoustic fabrics for automotive noise control, emergency escape chute components, therapeutic bedding, medical fabrics, protective apparel, and window treatment fabrics. The company maintains long-standing customer relationships through collaborative R&D and a focus on product quality.

Precision Fabrics was the first ISO-qualified textile supplier in the United States, achieving ISO 9001 registration in 1993 and updating to ISO 9001:2015 in 2018. The company says its differentiation lies in the breadth of its technical capabilities, the depth of its team's expertise, and a commitment to innovation that drives problem-solving across diverse markets.

name: Precision Molding Services Inc
old_description: provides more than 600 different varieties of custom-designed, plastic injection
about:
Precision Molding, Inc. (PMI) operates from Sparta, Tennessee, where it was founded in 1987 by Sarah and Doug together with co‑partner Mr. Phillips; the couple later bought out Phillips’ interest and have run the company since.

The shop specializes in high‑pressure injection, insert and blow molding, running more than 40 thermoplastic presses — including injection, vertical and blow molding machines from Van Dorn, Nissei and Milacron — with blow molding shot sizes from 5 to 25 pounds. Secondary operations include pad printing, hot stamping, metal stamping and assembly, plus design‑for‑manufacturability consulting and mold fabrication through a partner tool shop. PMI produces over 600 distinct part numbers for a varied customer base.

Customers span multiple sectors; a named example is Tree‑Guard Inc., for which PMI injection‑molds a nursery‑industry product. The company emphasizes a collaborative, customer‑driven approach from concept through production.

PMI cites its ISO 9001:2015 certification, a clean, climate‑controlled production environment and a zero‑defect quality goal as differentiators, aiming to deliver value‑added service and precision molding in a single source.

The shop provides full-service custom plastic injection molding, handling projects from conceptualization and design through mold development and final production. Its capabilities cover mold design, tooling, and production runs, with experience in high-performance materials such as PEEK and elastomers for aerospace applications.

The company serves medical and dental device manufacturers, as well as aerospace customers. A testimonial from a medical device producer highlights the firm's ability to meet stringent specifications and deliver "Made in the USA" parts.

Precision Molds differentiates itself through decades of expertise, a focus on customization, rigorous quality assurance systems including inspection protocols and comprehensive testing, and a commitment to short lead times and responsive customer service. The president cites clear communication and reliable products as foundations of the business.
